title: Anatomy of a passage
back: Skim: first paragraph, topic sentences, last paragraph; label each paragraph. Scan the rest for keywords only.

title: The two-pass method
back: Skim P1 → topic sentences → last P → read items, circle negatives → scan to keywords → answer, lift phrases, check.

title: NEON — circle the negative
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Four words that flip an item" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="30" y="70" width="60" height="50" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="60.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Not</text><rect x="98" y="70" width="60" height="50" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="128.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Except</text><rect x="166" y="70" width="60" height="50" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="196.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Only</text><rect x="234" y="70" width="60" height="50" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="264.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Never</text><text x="160" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">they reverse what the item asks</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Four words that flip an item</text></svg>
back: 'Which is NOT a reason…' — circle it before reading the options; the commonest avoidable loss in Section A.

title: One mark = one lift
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Copy the key phrase for 1-mark short answers" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="50" y="40" width="220" height="60" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="none" rx="6"/><rect x="90" y="58" width="110" height="22" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none" rx="3"/><path d="M145,100 L145,140 M140.2,131.2 L145,140 L149.8,131.2" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="90" y="142" width="110" height="22" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" rx="3"/><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Copy the key phrase for 1-mark short answers</text></svg>
back: Rewriting invites errors. Rewrite only for inference and 2-mark items, where understanding must show.

title: Inference = point + evidence
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Not stated — but the only sensible conclusion" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="70" width="100" height="50" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="90.0" y="99.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">point</text><text x="160" y="102" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">+</text><rect x="180" y="70" width="100" height="50" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="230.0" y="99.55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">evidence</text><text x="160" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">2 marks: 1 + 1</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Not stated — but the only sensible conclusion</text></svg>
back: State what must be true, then the phrase or fact from the text that shows it. Never infer beyond what the passage supports.

title: 18–20 minutes
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="2 skim · 1 read items · 12–14 answer · 1–2 check" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g opacity="0.9"><circle cx="160" cy="95" r="60" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M160.0,43.0 L160.0,37.0 M186.0,50.0 L189.0,44.8 M205.0,69.0 L210.2,66.0 M212.0,95.0 L218.0,95.0 M205.0,121.0 L210.2,124.0 M186.0,140.0 L189.0,145.2 M160.0,147.0 L160.0,153.0 M134.0,140.0 L131.0,145.2 M115.0,121.0 L109.8,124.0 M108.0,95.0 L102.0,95.0 M115.0,69.0 L109.8,66.0 M134.0,50.0 L131.0,44.8 " fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M160,95 L165.2,65.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M160,95 L199.0,117.5" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="160" cy="95" r="4" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><text x="160" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Section A first, while fresh</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">2 skim · 1 read items · 12–14 answer · 1–2 check</text></svg>
back: Section A takes 30–35 minutes of the three hours: Q1 about 18–20, Q2 about 12–15. Do it first, not last.

title: Point to the line
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Every answer needs its evidence" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="28" y="40" width="264" height="90" rx="10" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="160" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Point to the line</text><text x="160" y="155" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">every answer needs its evidence</text></svg>
back: For every answer, point to the line or fact in the passage that proves it. No line, no mark: rewrite until you can point.

title: Meaning from context
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Read around the word" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="28" y="40" width="264" height="90" rx="10" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="160" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Read around the word</text><text x="160" y="155" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">before and after, then decide</text></svg>
back: Read the sentence before and after the word. The meaning comes from the sentence, not from a word you already know.
